selected_story.title: Step Inside Ancient Parties: AI Recreates the Music and Feasts of Etruscan Tombs
selected_story.reason: Brings ancient celebrations, banquets, and music back to life in a vivid sensory journey that sparks wonder.
selected_story.title_en: AI Recreates the Music and Banquets of Ancient Etruscan Tombs
selected_story.reason_en: An inspiring look at how artificial intelligence brings ancient celebrations, music, and banquets back to life in a rich sensory experience.
selected_story.en_copy: Artificial intelligence is bringing ancient celebrations back to life by recreating the music and feasts depicted in Etruscan tombs. This creative technology allows people to step inside history and experience the vivid sounds and banquets of ancient gatherings.
selected_story.duck_en: Quack! Party like it's ancient times with AI-recreated music and feasts!
selected_story.x_en: AI is recreating the music and banquets of ancient Etruscan tombs, letting us experience historic celebrations firsthand.
selected_story.title_ja: AIが古代エトルリアの墓に描かれた音楽や宴を再現
selected_story.reason_ja: AI技術を活用して古代のお祝いや音楽、宴を蘇らせ、歴史への好奇心を刺激する夢のあるストーリーです。
selected_story.jp_copy: 人工知能を活用して、古代エトルリアの墓に描かれた音楽や宴を再現する取り組みが行われています。この創造的な技術により、当時の賑やかな集まりの音や雰囲気を体感し、まるで古代のお祝いの場に足を踏み入れたかのような感覚を味わうことができます。
selected_story.duck_jp: クワッ！AIが再現した音楽と宴で、古代のパーティーを楽しもう！
selected_story.x_jp: AIが古代エトルリアの墓に描かれた音楽や宴を再現し、当時の賑やかなお祝いの雰囲気を体感できるようになりました。

gate_a_package.recommended_reason: Ants rushing to rescue their endangered friends is a charming, heartwarming, and deeply relatable animal story that brings instant warmth, high visual appeal, and delightful conversation value to everyday readers.

story_options.title: In Ant Communities, Brave Workers Rush to Rescue Nestmates in Distress
story_options.reason: A heartwarming and delightful look at how tiny ants step up to help their nestmates in trouble, offering instant charm and great conversation value.
story_options.title_en: Brave Ants Rush to Rescue Nestmates in Need
story_options.reason_en: A heartwarming look at how tiny worker ants step up to rescue their nestmates in distress, showcasing cooperation and charm in nature.
story_options.en_copy: In ant communities, brave worker ants rush to aid nestmates that find themselves in distress. This charming observation highlights the remarkable teamwork present in tiny creatures, showing how nestmates pull together to help one another out of tough situations.
story_options.duck_en: Quack! Even the tiniest worker can be a big hero to a nestmate!
story_options.x_en: Brave worker ants rush to rescue their nestmates in distress, demonstrating big teamwork in tiny packages.
story_options.title_ja: 困っている仲間を救うため駆けつける勇敢なアリたち
story_options.reason_ja: 困っている仲間を助ける小さな働きアリの姿を通して、自然界における協力関係と魅力を伝える心温まるニュースです。
story_options.jp_copy: アリの社会では、困った状況に陥った仲間を救うため、勇敢な働きアリたちが駆けつけます。この微笑ましい出来事は、小さな生き物たちが互いに協力し合い、助け合う素晴らしいチームワークを示しています。
story_options.duck_jp: クワッ！どんなに小さな働きアリでも、仲間にとっては大ヒーローなんだね！
story_options.x_jp: 困っている仲間を救うために勇敢な働きアリが駆けつける、小さな体の中に宿る大きなチームワークの物語です。

story_options.title: NASA Hosts Accessible Space Webinar for the Blind and Low-Vision Community
story_options.reason: An uplifting and inclusive story showing how space exploration can be shared warmly with everyone through thoughtful accessibility.
story_options.title_en: NASA Hosts Accessible Space Webinar for the Blind and Low-Vision Community
story_options.reason_en: An uplifting and inclusive effort by NASA to make space exploration accessible and inspiring for the blind and low-vision community.
story_options.en_copy: NASA is bringing the wonder of space exploration to everyone by hosting an accessible webinar tailored for the blind and low-vision community. Focusing on accessibility and inclusion, the virtual event shares the excitement of space discovery and missions like Artemis in a warm and welcoming format.
story_options.duck_en: Quack! Space exploration is for everyone to experience and enjoy!
story_options.x_en: NASA is hosting an accessible space webinar for the blind and low-vision community, making cosmic discovery inclusive for all.
story_options.title_ja: NASAが視覚障害・ロービジョンコミュニティ向けのバリアフリー宇宙ウェビナーを開催
story_options.reason_ja: 視覚障害やロービジョンの方々に宇宙探査の魅力を届ける、NASAの包摂的で心温まる取り組みを紹介します。
story_options.jp_copy: NASAは、視覚障害やロービジョンコミュニティ向けに配慮されたオンラインウェビナーを開催し、宇宙探査のワクワク感を届けています。アクセシビリティと包摂性を重視したこのイベントでは、アルテミス計画などの宇宙探査の魅力を誰もが楽しめる形で共有しています。
story_options.duck_jp: クワッ！宇宙探査のワクワクは、みんなで楽しむものだね！
story_options.x_jp: NASAが視覚障害やロービジョンの方向けにアクセシブルな宇宙ウェビナーを開催し、誰もが宇宙の発見を楽しめる機会を届けています。

story_options.title: A Longer Exhale May Push Your Brain Toward Bolder Decisions
story_options.reason: A simple, fun life hack that sparks positive curiosity about how our breathing influences confidence and choice.
story_options.title_en: A Longer Exhale May Encourage Bolder Decisions
story_options.reason_en: A simple and intriguing insight into how breathing out a little longer might influence brain function and support confident decision-making.
story_options.en_copy: Taking time for a longer exhale may do more than just help you relax—it might also nudge your brain toward making bolder decisions. This fun breathwork insight highlights the curious connection between simple body rhythms and everyday choices.
story_options.duck_en: Quack! Take a long exhale and get ready to make your next move!
story_options.x_en: Exhaling longer might help push your brain toward bolder choices—a simple breathing trick for everyday confidence!
story_options.title_ja: 息を長めにはくことで、より大胆な決断ができるかも
story_options.reason_ja: 息を長く吐くという簡単な動作が脳や自信に与える影響について、ポジティブな好奇心を刺激するニュースです。
story_options.jp_copy: 息を長めにはくことは、リラックスするだけでなく、脳をより大胆な決断へと後押しする効果があるかもしれません。この身近な呼吸のコツは、日々のシンプルな身体のリズムと意思決定との興味深い繋がりを教えてくれます。
story_options.duck_jp: クワッ！息をふーっと長く吐いて、次の一歩を踏み出そう！
story_options.x_jp: 息を長めにはくことで、より大胆な選択へと脳が押し出されるかもしれません。日常で試せる簡単な呼吸の知恵です！

story_options.title: Your Dislike of Eating Bugs May Be a 9,000-Year-Old Human Habit
story_options.reason: An amusing and highly relatable historical insight into everyday food preferences that readers will enjoy sharing with friends.
story_options.title_en: Your Reluctance to Eat Insects May Be a 9,000-Year-Old Habit
story_options.reason_en: An amusing historical story exploring how our modern aversion to eating bugs might be a deeply rooted habit dating back thousands of years.
story_options.en_copy: If you hesitate at the thought of eating insects, you are not alone—and the habit might be 9,000 years old. Research suggests that this familiar food preference has deep roots in human history, making our modern dining hesitation a relatable trait shared across millennia.
story_options.duck_en: Quack! Don't worry, skipping the bugs is a time-tested tradition!
story_options.x_en: Disliking eating bugs might actually be a 9,000-year-old human habit—a funny food preference with deep historical roots!
story_options.title_ja: 昆虫食への抵抗感は9,000年前からの習慣かも？
story_options.reason_ja: 私たちが虫を食べることに抵抗を感じる理由が、実は何千年も前からの習慣かもしれないという、クスッと笑えて親しみやすい話題です。
story_options.jp_copy: 昆虫を食べることに抵抗を感じるなら、あなただけではありません。その感覚は9,000年前からの習慣である可能性があります。この身近な食の好みが人類の歴史に深く根ざしているという発見は、何千年もの時を超えた親しみやすい事実を教えてくれます。
story_options.duck_jp: クワッ！昆虫を避けるのは、長年受け継がれてきた伝統なんだね！
story_options.x_jp: 虫を食べるのが苦手なのは、実は9,000年前から続く人類の習慣かもしれません。歴史を感じる面白い食の話題です！
